text:
maya: heads-up — payments placed CORP-4720 on hold after a bank chargeback and a huge usage spike. need to assemble dispute evidence bundle.

payments-bot: Hold created for account CORP-4720 by payments-team at 2025-10-10T07:20:34Z. Trigger: chargeback gw_tx_9b3 + auth failures.

tom: Summary from billing table: INV-2025-10-01-300 $32,450 paid 2025-10-02T01:12Z (card ****1111); INV-2025-10-02-301 $128,900 declined; INV-2025-10-02-302 $115,600 chargeback gw_tx_9b3 filed 2025-10-03T05:40Z.

sasha: please confirm gateway dispute id and attach bank packet when it arrives. also need API key creation logs and IP list for the spike window (2025-10-01..2025-10-03).

liam: support forwarded an email from the customer's sec team at 07:23 claiming they didn't authorize the spend. forwarded to billing and legal. customer incident id SEC-2025-10-07-17.

aisha: legal checklist: signed PO or contract clause, invoice copies, customer dispute email, gateway dispute packet, proof-of-service (examples of outputs delivered), and export provenance (who pulled logs and when). If keys were created under SSO, treat as internal compromise — different playbook.

maya: eng-infra asked for this query: SELECT request_id, api_key_id, src_ip, user_agent, timestamp FROM api_access_logs WHERE account_id='CORP-4720' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-10-03'; can someone run and drop redacted CSV into s3://redwood-evidence/CORP-4720/2025-10-10/.

tom: uploaded redacted billing export and gateway ticket to s3://redwood-evidence/CORP-4720/2025-10-10/ (charges.csv, gw_tx_9b3.pdf). link expires in 14 days.

sasha: ran the query and flagged three new api_key_ids created from unusual IPs. uploaded api-extract.csv (redacted) to the same S3 path.

liam: customer security team says new keys originated from an IP range outside their corporate CIDR. they're investigating and will send a short incident report by EOD PST.

aisha: legal prefers we keep the account on hold but allow read-only access for the customer to pull logs. to re-enable writes require a signed confirmation from their security lead or procurement.

maya: agree. propose read-only access until we have gateway packet + customer's incident report. if we get docs within 48 hours, we'll escalate with collections/legal for resolution.

tom: tagging account metadata: hold_reason=chargeback, hold_owner=billing_ops. scheduling collections review in 7 business days if unresolved.

ops-bot: Note added on account CORP-4720: evidence_collection_started by maya at 2025-10-10T07:25:01Z.

maya: please drop any additional artifacts in the S3 folder and confirm here when done. i'll compile timeline and send to legal + collections.

sasha: uploaded bank packet when it arrived and linked it in the S3 folder.

liam: pinged customer for the incident report; they acknowledged.

aisha: legal reviewing gateway packet and will advise on provisional chargeback stance. if bank upholds dispute we may need to adjust revenue recognition and consider collections depending on contract.

maya: thanks all — keeping this thread as single source of truth. closing loop for now.
